source.name: San Diego FC – 'San Diego FC Unveils the 2026 Unprecedented Unity Kit'
source.quote: DIRECTV, SDFC’s Official Jersey Partner, will be prominently featured on the front of the Unprecedented Unity Kit.
source.note: Multi-year front-of-kit deal announced July 2024 (deal: san-diego-fc-directv); the club's 2026 kit launch confirms it continues through the 2026 MLS season.

source.name: San Diego FC – 'Adriana’s Insurance Joins San Diego FC as Official Jersey Sleeve Partner and Founding Partner'
source.quote: the Adriana’s Insurance logo will be featured on the right sleeve of all SDFC’s MLS primary and secondary jerseys worn during all club competitions
source.note: Multi-year right-sleeve deal (deal: san-diego-fc-adrianas-insurance-sleeve); the club's 2026 kit launch (2026-02-10) repeats the placement for the 2026 kit.

source.name: SportsLogos.Net – 'MLS to Allow Back-of-Jersey Ads Starting After 2026 All-Star Break'
source.quote: All 30 MLS clubs feature the Apple TV+ logo on the left sleeve patch as part of a league-wide deal.
source.note: League-wide sleeve patch (league deal: mls-apple-tv); Apple pays MLS, not the club. SportsLogos 403s script fetches from datacenter IPs; the page was opened and the quote verified on 2026-10-03. Same placement documented by For Soccer's 2026 MLS jersey sponsors list (2026-02-17).

summary: 2026 'Unprecedented Unity' home kit, made by Adidas. DIRECTV fronts the jersey; Adriana's Insurance has the right sleeve; the league-wide Apple TV patch is on the left sleeve of every MLS kit. MLS opened a lower-back ad slot after the 2026 All-Star break; San Diego FC has announced no back sponsor.
